posts.name: Silverleaf
posts.cooked:
Right, well since I'm seeing two different colour schemes in Visionary's artwork, I made the executive decion to go with the following: Suit in royal blue, cape in green, boots and gloves in green with black trim, section of skin showing behind the lacing on the front of the suit. She matches the deck art but not the character card art or the picture Ronway posted - I had to make a decision one way or the other and I think the increased contrast using blue rather than teal is more pleasing. She's still very obviously Visionary and I'm happy with how she's shaping up.

I now just need to sew on her cape and embroider the lacing. Should be done in an hour.

Next, finish Unity, who needs new boots and some goggles.

And after that? Well, I'm not sure. Either AZ or Tempest, I guess. I plan to do them all eventually, but it might take some time! ;)
